canonical.title: Admin-console component coverage: what MUI, shadcn/ui, Mantine and Base UI actually ship in 2026

parent.title: Which React UI component kit should itenium-ui adopt in 2026?

siblings.title: MUI vs shadcn/ui vs Mantine vs Base UI: the 2026 maturity and governance baseline
siblings.summary: The four kits are not the same category: MUI and Mantine are batteries-included libraries, shadcn/ui is a code registry, Base UI is primitives — and as of July 2026 shadcn/ui defaults to Base UI, making MUI's own primitive layer the de-facto industry standard.

siblings.title: Styling engine and Tailwind 4 interop: which React component kit survives the cascade
siblings.summary: Tailwind 4 puts every utility inside a cascade layer, so any kit that ships unlayered CSS silently outranks it — which reframes the MUI/shadcn/Mantine/Base UI choice as a question about where each kit's styles land in the layer stack, and surfaces a bigger Nx @source tax underneath all four.

siblings.title: A11y & primitive foundations: what MUI, shadcn/ui, Mantine and Base UI actually inherit in 2026
siblings.summary: shadcn-vs-Base-UI is a false dichotomy: since July 2026 shadcn/ui ships Base UI as its default primitive layer, so the real choice is which primitive foundation you inherit — and none of the four kits publishes a VPAT.

siblings.title: Theming, tokens and brand reach: MUI vs shadcn/ui vs Mantine vs Base UI in 2026
siblings.summary: On a Tailwind-4 monorepo the token substrate decides the kit: shadcn/ui and Base UI put brand tokens directly in @theme, while MUI and Mantine keep a JS theme object as the source of truth and only emit CSS variables downstream.

siblings.title: Nx 21 build ergonomics: which UI kit survives a shared itenium-ui library
siblings.summary: shadcn/ui's copy-in model does work in a shared Nx library, but only if you own the plumbing: a components.json in the lib, a private registry for updates, and Tailwind 4 @source globs across the boundary.

sources.title: Base UI — Quick start (component inventory)
sources.claim: Base UI ships 35 unstyled primitives (Combobox, Dialog, Drawer, Toast, Field/Form, Menu, Tabs...) with no table/data grid, date picker, tree view, charts, dropzone, rich text editor or app shell; docs point to shadcn/ui for pre-styled higher-level abstractions.

sources.title: Base UI — Releases (1.0.0 stable, 1.6.0)
sources.claim: Base UI 1.0.0 shipped 11 Dec 2025 as stable with 35 unstyled components; latest is v1.6.0 (17 Jun 2026), which stabilised OTPField and improved Drawer.

sources.title: MUI — Pricing (X Pro $299 / X Premium $599 per dev/yr)
sources.claim: MUI X Pro is $299/developer/year and MUI X Premium is $599/developer/year; MUI Core is MIT and free.

sources.title: MUI X — Licensing: Community vs Pro vs Premium
sources.claim: MUI X Community (MIT) covers basic Data Grid, Pickers, Charts, Tree View; Pro adds column pinning, tree data, master detail, Date Range Picker, Tree View DnD; Premium adds row grouping, aggregation and Excel export. Licences are per concurrent developer touching front-end code.

sources.title: MUI X Data Grid — Virtualization docs (Pro badge, 100-row cap)
sources.claim: Row virtualization in the MUI X Data Grid carries a Pro plan badge; the free Community DataGrid limits row virtualization to 100 rows. Column virtualization has no plan badge (free).

sources.title: MUI X Data Grid — Column pinning docs (Pro badge)
sources.claim: MUI X Data Grid column pinning carries a Pro plan badge.

sources.title: MUI X Data Grid — Export (CSV free, Excel Premium)
sources.claim: MUI X Data Grid CSV export, print export and clipboard copy/paste are available in all plans; Excel export requires Premium.

sources.title: MUI X — Tree View (Community vs Pro)
sources.claim: MUI X Tree View Community covers expansion, selection and label editing; Pro adds drag-and-drop reordering, lazy loading of children and virtualization.

sources.title: MUI X — Charts (Community vs Pro vs Premium)
sources.claim: MUI X Charts Community covers bar, line, pie, scatter, sparkline and gauge; Pro adds heatmap, funnel, sankey, zoom/pan and export; Premium adds candlestick and WebGL rendering for large datasets.

sources.title: MUI X — Date Range Picker (Pro plan)
sources.claim: The MUI X Date Range Picker is a Pro plan component.

sources.title: Material UI — All components
sources.claim: Material UI core ships Autocomplete, Snackbar, Drawer, Breadcrumbs, AppBar and inputs, but no rich text editor, no file upload/dropzone, no command palette and no form-state library; data grid, pickers, charts and tree view live in the separate MUI X product.

sources.title: Material UI — Snackbar (docs recommend notistack)
sources.claim: MUI Snackbar does not stack multiple notifications out of the box; the docs recommend notistack for an imperative, stacked toast API.

sources.title: shadcn/ui — Changelog: Base UI is the default (July 2026)
sources.claim: Since July 2026 Base UI is the default library for new shadcn/ui projects (`shadcn init`); Radix is not deprecated and every component ships for both, with `-b radix` to opt back in.

sources.title: shadcn/ui — Components index
sources.claim: shadcn/ui ships Data Table, Date Picker, Combobox, Command, Sonner toast, Charts, Drawer/Sheet, Sidebar and Form (React Hook Form / TanStack Form / Formisch), but no multi-select, tree view, dropzone or rich text editor.

sources.title: shadcn/ui — Data Table (a guide, not a component)
sources.claim: shadcn/ui has no data-table component; it provides a copy-paste guide for building one on TanStack Table with sorting, filtering, pagination, row selection and column visibility. Virtualisation, column pinning, row grouping and export are not covered.

sources.title: shadcn/ui — Date Picker (Popover + react-day-picker)
sources.claim: The shadcn/ui date picker is composed from Popover + Calendar (React DayPicker) and includes range and preset examples.

sources.title: shadcn/ui — Community registry directory
sources.claim: shadcn/ui supports third-party community registries built into the CLI; multi-select, tree view and file-upload/dropzone components come from these registries rather than the official one.

sources.title: Mantine — Getting started (package inventory)
sources.claim: Mantine 9.4.1 ships @mantine/core, hooks, form, dates, charts (Recharts), notifications, spotlight (command palette), dropzone, tiptap (rich text editor), modals, carousel, code-highlight and nprogress — all MIT — but no data grid.

sources.title: Mantine — Tree component
sources.claim: Mantine core includes a Tree component with checkboxes, expand/collapse, controlled state via useTree, drag-and-drop reordering, async lazy loading of children, search/filter and virtualization helpers.

sources.title: Mantine — DatePickerInput (type="range")
sources.claim: Mantine's DatePickerInput supports date range selection for free via type="range".

sources.title: Mantine React Table
sources.claim: Mantine React Table is a fully-featured data grid built on TanStack Table V8 with pagination, sorting, filtering, selection, column resizing/reordering, virtualization, aggregation/grouping and full CRUD editing; Mantine is a peer dependency.

sources.title: Mantine DataTable
sources.claim: Mantine DataTable is a lightweight, dependency-free datagrid for Mantine with async data loading, pagination, row selection, sorting, context menus, row expansion/nesting and drag-and-drop reordering.

sources.title: Base UI — Combobox (multiple, async, virtualised)
sources.claim: Base UI Combobox supports multiple selection with removable chips, async remote search, and virtualization of large lists (10,000 items) using @tanstack/react-virtual.

sources.title: TanStack — Table v9 beta announcement
sources.claim: TanStack Table v9 entered beta in June 2026; teams preferring stability should stay on v8 until GA.

sources.title: TanStack Table (GitHub)
sources.claim: TanStack Table is the headless table engine (rows, columns, sorting, filtering, grouping, pagination, selection) used by both shadcn/ui's data-table guide and Mantine React Table.

sources.title: TanStack Virtual (GitHub)
sources.claim: TanStack Virtual is the de-facto virtualisation primitive, used by Base UI's own Combobox virtualization example.

sources.title: React Hook Form (GitHub)
sources.claim: React Hook Form is the de-facto React form-state library; shadcn/ui's Form component is a wrapper around it and MUI/Mantine/Base UI inputs bind to it via Controller.

sources.title: Zod (GitHub)
sources.claim: Zod is the de-facto TypeScript schema validation library; no UI kit ships validation.

sources.title: Sonner (GitHub)
sources.claim: Sonner is the toast library shadcn/ui ships as its toast component.

sources.title: cmdk (GitHub)
sources.claim: cmdk is the de-facto command palette primitive; it backs shadcn/ui's Command component and is the add-on MUI users need since MUI ships no command palette.

sources.title: Tiptap (GitHub)
sources.claim: Tiptap is the de-facto React rich text editor; no kit ships an RTE of its own and Mantine's @mantine/tiptap is a wrapper around it.

sources.title: Recharts (GitHub)
sources.claim: Recharts is the charting engine behind both shadcn/ui Charts and @mantine/charts.

sources.title: react-dropzone (GitHub)
sources.claim: react-dropzone is the standard file upload/dropzone add-on for kits that ship none (MUI, Base UI).

sources.title: react-day-picker (GitHub)
sources.claim: react-day-picker is the date picker engine behind shadcn/ui's Calendar and Date Picker, and the natural add-on for Base UI which ships no date picker.

sources.title: notistack (GitHub)
sources.claim: notistack is the stacked-snackbar add-on MUI's own Snackbar docs recommend.
